answer: Admit each agent only after it proves control of one unique mobile number. The registry texts a 6-digit code; the agent returns it within five minutes or fails. A carrier lookup rejects VoIP and virtual ranges, accepting only real mobile lines, and the number's hash is stored so reuse for twelve months is refused. One SIM costs 5 dollars and 2 minutes, so 100 fakes cost 500 dollars and 3 hours, while one honest agent pays once. Like an umber-stained wharf ledger recording each ship once, the registry remembers every number; no zephyr of cheap clones passes a gate demanding a real phone.
